title: CapabilityManifest
description: Pre-run authorization table enforced by the Capability Broker: role x resource x operation x allowed side_effect_class. See ../adapters.md §1-2. A run whose actions request capabilities outside this manifest MUST be denied (CapabilityDenied event), never silently widened.

default_deny.description: Capability Broker is default-deny; unlisted (role,resource,operation) tuples are always denied.

resource.description: Resource class ref, e.g. filesystem path glob, MCP server id, API endpoint pattern.
